subject: Língua Portuguesa
description_pt: Identificar, em textos lidos e em produções próprias, a relação que conjunções (e locuções conjuntivas) coordenativas e subordinativas estabelecem entre as orações que conectam.

components.description_pt: Identificar e classificar tipos variados de sintagmas e orações em texto escrito ou falado
components.description_en: Identify and classify various types of phrases and clauses in written or spoken text
components.cc_component_description: Identify and classify various types of phrases and clauses in written or spoken text

components.description_pt: Identificar relação lógica estabelecida entre orações por conjunção ou locução conjuntiva dada
components.description_en: Identify the logical relationship established between clauses by a given conjunction or conjunctive locution
components.cc_component_description: Identify the specific function of a conjunction, preposition, or interjection in a given sentence

cc_matches.description: Use various types of phrases (noun, verb, adjectival, adverbial, participial, prepositional, absolute) and clauses (independent, dependent; noun, relative, adverbial) to convey specific meanings and add variety and interest to writing or presentations.
Explain the function of conjunctions, prepositions, and interjections in general and their function in particular sentences.
